author: Castjr
title: A saddening account of great game
content:
Used to be a great game when junniper developed it, rewarded players for playing/grinding the game and even more if you spend some money on it. Had its problems but you could see devs trying to do a good game.
Now with Kong, it slowly but surely turned into a freemium cash grab, unless you dump a LOT of money, don’t expect much. The game is riddled with bugs, constant crashes, game braking itens, the devs saying one thing than doing another(ok this one is not a bug, maybe management?),friend list that doesn’t show who is on/off line, armory that doesn’t work properly( this one is persisting for years now). It is what it is, a game who used to be good who got sold to a company that don’t care that much about game experience, just the ca$h.
Good luck for you new players, I’m starting to pack my things to leave.
